answer: Resist Sybil identities with proof-of-unique-work: each new agent must keep a verified compute reservation, a beacon of signed heartbeat proofs tied to hardware-bound timing challenges. Forking one hundred fake identities means paying for one hundred separate reservations, so cost scales linearly with the fakes, and a summit of sampled auditors can slash any identity whose proofs reuse the same machine. Like saffron, real capacity is costly to counterfeit.
